_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/settings.local.json and edit. Claude Code merges this on top of ~/.claude/settings.json (the symlinked common file). Set a plugin to false to disable a common one on this machine; add new ones to enable per-machine extras. The model/effortLevel/alwaysThinkingEnabled/tui/theme keys below are per-machine preferences kept OUT of the synced common file — override each as this machine needs.
